title: Products and exponentials in the Joyal homotopy category
statement:
Use the Joyal model structure and categorical equivalences of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], the coherent-nerve adjunction $\mathfrak C\dashv N_{\mathrm{hc}}$ of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and the universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Write $h\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathrm J}$ for the ordinary localization of simplicial sets at categorical equivalences, and $[X,Y]_{\mathrm J}$ for its Hom sets. For simplicial sets $K,L$, their degreewise product represents the categorical product in this homotopy category, and the natural functor
$$\mathfrak C[K\times L]\longrightarrow\mathfrak C[K]\times\mathfrak C[L]$$
is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence. For every quasicategory $Q$, define $\operatorname{Fun}(K,Q)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathsf{sSet}}(K\times\Delta^n,Q)$. This is a quasicategory, and evaluation induces natural bijections
$$[X,\operatorname{Fun}(K,Q)]_{\mathrm J}\ \cong\ [X\times K,Q]_{\mathrm J}.$$
These bijections use the actual simplicial evaluation map. In particular $\operatorname{Fun}(K,Q)$ represents $[Q]^{[K]}$ in the Joyal homotopy category, not just an exponential of ordinary homotopy categories.
